findings.statement: Liveness must be multi-layered: declared/installed -> process active -> endpoint responsive -> dependency-ready -> semantically ready. Treating systemd active as health was historically false.
Desired topology and instantiated topology are different objects. Optional/absent services must not enter failure/restart accounting as failed nodes.

Blind heartbeat petting is not sufficient as a final Clay design: long operations need phase/deadline leases so a stuck operation cannot remain indefinitely healthy merely because another heartbeat continues.
Supervisor feedback can create the very instability it measures. Restart actions, watchdog lifecycle messages and dependency failures need causal provenance and anti-cascade budgets.

harness: BOOT_GRAPH_REALITY: freeze expected modules/services for a build, then compare to actually instantiated capabilities before health scoring.
LIVENESS_LADDER: test installed/deployed, process-active, endpoint-responsive, dependency-ready and semantic-readiness separately.
PHASE_DEADLINE_RECEIPTS: every long sensor/tool/model operation emits phase start, deadline/progress and terminal outcome; missed deadline must be distinguishable from process death.
CASCADE_INJECTION_TEST: optional service absent, one required service hung, one dependency unavailable; supervisor must recover only causal targets and preserve healthy nodes.
STARTUP_ORDER_FACTORIAL: replay boot orders and verify same authoritative state/ready graph after convergence, or explicitly record order dependence as failure.
claycode: Encode module/service capability presence and dependency edges in compiled runtime metadata instead of hardcoded supervisor lists.
Make liveness/readiness/terminal-outcome types first-class so supervisor policy can be statically and dynamically checked.
h3_one_module_frank: One-module does not remove boot ordering; it moves ordering inside initialization phases. Require deterministic initialization DAG, phase receipts, rollback to last-known-good initialization snapshot and no hidden optional-node restart loops.
unifieddb: Persist boot epoch id, module presence, dependency graph version, readiness transitions, restart cause/effect, phase deadlines and recovery outcome so crashes cannot erase the causal boot story.
needle: Tool/model calls whose process exists but readiness/endpoint is unhealthy must route as unavailable/degraded, not as normal execution followed by timeout.

regression_suite: R1 systemd-active + HTTP-hung model must be detected without killing unrelated services
R2 startup grace prevents false restart during legitimate cold model load
R3 absent optional service is classified ABSENT_OPTIONAL, never FAILED
R4 absent required service produces explicit boot-gate failure, not cascade restart storm
R5 long sensor/tool phase crosses normal heartbeat interval but reports phase progress and survives
R6 intentionally stuck long phase misses deadline and is recovered despite process heartbeat
R7 restart/lifecycle logs cannot recursively trigger supervisor recovery
R8 boot-order permutation either converges to identical ready state hash or fails the deterministic-boot gate
